name: Card
description: A surface that groups related content so it reads as one unit, like a project, a summary or a block of settings. It can react to hover when it's clickable, and it has a media version for captures, recordings and pictures.

classes.ayy-card--sm: Tighter: 12px padding on the header, content and footer, a sm title and an xs description.
classes.ayy-card--lg: Roomier: 24px padding and an lg title.
classes.ayy-card--interactive: Lifts on hover (mouse and trackpad only, so a tap doesn't leave it lifted). Use when the whole card is clickable.
classes.ayy-card--spotlight: Pointer-following glow + lit border. Colour via the --ayy-spot custom property.
classes.ayy-card--transparent: No fill and no rest shadow: the page shows through. The line border, radius and padding stay. Pairs with spotlight for rows on a plain page.
classes.ayy-card--featured: The one to pick: the recommended plan in a pricing grid, or the option someone chose. A 2px border in the text colour (High Contrast: a highlight outline). One per group.
classes.ayy-card__title: Heading. Use an h2–h4 that fits your outline.
classes.ayy-card__footer: Actions row, pinned to the bottom.
classes.ayy-card__media: Edge-to-edge image, screenshot or video. Rounds the card corners it touches (first or last child); zooms slightly when an interactive card is hovered with a mouse.
classes.ayy-card__link: Put on the title's <a>: it stretches over the whole card, so the card is one link and one tab stop. Other links and buttons inside stay clickable.
classes.ayy-card--view: View type: a capture, recording or picture to open. The picture fills the card and clips to its corners; Hover actions float in its corners.
classes.ayy-card__view-media: View: the picture's box at --ayy-ratio (default 16 / 10). A <button> or <a> when opening it is the card's main action.
classes.ayy-card__view-backdrop: View: a blurred copy of the picture filling the box around the letterboxed picture (aria-hidden).
classes.ayy-card__view-image: View: the picture itself, letterboxed (object-fit: contain), never cropped.
classes.ayy-card__view-badge: View: frosted pill in the top start corner — a recording's kind and length ("0:42").
classes.ayy-card__view-play: View: frosted round play glyph in the top end corner. Fades when the card is hovered so the actions can take the corner.
classes.ayy-card__view-body: View: title, details and badges on a gradient over the bottom of the picture. Revealed on hover; clicks go through to the picture.
classes.ayy-card__view-text: View: column of the title and the details; truncates.
classes.ayy-card__view-title: View: the card's name in sm semibold, one line.
classes.ayy-card__view-meta: View: details in xs soft text with tabular figures — size, length, age.
classes.ayy-card__view-badges: View: row of Badges at the end of the body (Edited, Uploaded).

default.looks: Surface fill, line border, card radius and the rest shadow; header, content and footer padded --ayy-space-5. transparent drops the fill and the rest shadow.

hover.when: :hover; on a view card also [data-hover] (hover tracked elsewhere)
hover.looks: Border turns line-hover. interactive also lifts 2px with the lift shadow and zooms its media 3%; spotlight lights a glow and border that follow the pointer. A view card takes the lift shadow, its body fades up from 6px below, a --reveal Hover actions row fades in and the play glyph fades out.

pressed.none: No pressed look, even when interactive.

focus.looks: The ring goes around the whole card (2px, 2px offset) when its title link has keyboard focus. On a view card the ring sits inside the picture's edge, and focus anywhere in it reveals the body and actions like hover.

disabled.none: Cards aren't disabled; dim nothing. For an unavailable option use a Choice card with a disabled input.

selected.looks: Text-colour border plus a 1px ring, so it reads as 2px without moving. For a picked option use a Choice card instead. Forced colours: Highlight outline.

error.none: Put an Alert inside the card's content.

loading.none: No loading look; show Skeletons in the card's content shape (aria-busy on the region) — 16 / 10 for view cards.

menu-open.when: view card :has([aria-expanded="true"]), a menu inside it is open
menu-open.looks: Stays revealed while its ⋯ menu is open.

scale.sm: 12px padding on the header, content and footer; --ayy-text-sm title, --ayy-text-xs description.

sizes.density: Padding and text don't follow data-density.
sizes.width: Fills its grid cell or container; height follows content, and the footer sits at the bottom of a stretched card. A view card is as tall as its picture's box: --ayy-ratio of its width. Put view cards in .ayy-grid with --ayy-min (14–16rem).

js: cardClass({ size?, interactive?, spotlight?, transparent?, featured?, view?, className? }) → string; cardHeaderClass, cardTitleClass, cardDescriptionClass, cardContentClass, cardFooterClass, cardMediaClass, cardLinkClass constants; trackSpotlight(pointerEvent) sets --ayy-mx/--ayy-my.

react.import: import { Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter, CardMedia, CardLink, CardViewMedia, CardViewImage, CardViewBadge, CardViewPlay, CardViewBody, CardViewText, CardViewTitle, CardViewMeta, CardViewBadges } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";

props.size: "sm" | "md" | "lg" — padding of the header, content and footer, and the size of the title
props.spotlight: boolean — tracks the pointer for you
props.spotColor: CSS colour for the spotlight, e.g. "var(--ayy-accent-product)"
props.transparent: boolean — no fill, no rest shadow (ayy-card--transparent).
props.featured: boolean — the recommended or chosen card (ayy-card--featured).
props.view: boolean — the view type (ayy-card--view): a capture, recording or picture to open

props.children: An , ,

CardViewMedia.renders: <button class="ayy-card__view-media"> when given onClick, <a> with href, otherwise <div>

props.ratio: number | string — the box's shape, width ÷ height (1.6, or "1440 / 900"); default 16 / 10 so a grid lines up

CardViewImage.renders: + (src, alt, width and height go on the picture)

props.backdrop: string — a smaller copy for the blurred fill; default src

CardViewPlay.renders: <span class="ayy-card__view-play" aria-hidden="true"> with a play icon

a11y: If the whole card is a link, put ayy-card__link on the title's <a> — don't wrap the card in <a>. Screen readers then announce just the title, not the whole card.
Media images are content: give them alt text, or alt="" when the title already says it all.
Spotlight layers are pseudo-elements, invisible to assistive tech.

View cards: when the picture opens something, CardViewMedia is a <button> or <a> with an aria-label that names the item and the action ("Annotate the pricing page capture from 2 minutes ago"); the body is decoration on top of it.
View cards reveal their body and actions on focus as well as hover, and always show them on touch screens, so nothing is hover-only. The backdrop is aria-hidden.
do: Use a card to group a unit of content: a project, a person, a plan, a stat.
Add interactive for clickable tiles in a grid.
Use accent tokens (--ayy-accent-*) as spotColor to tie a card to a category.
Keep one level of cards; use hairline dividers inside.
Mark the recommended plan in a pricing grid with featured (and a Badge that says why), not a coloured background.

Use the view type (view) for captures, recordings and pictures people open — a screenshot history, a media library — in .ayy-grid; pass the picture's real width and height, and keep the box at 16 / 10 so rows line up (portrait pictures letterbox over the blur).
On a view card, group three or more actions in one Hover actions bar (top end, group, reveal) ending in a ⋯ DropdownMenu; show a recording's length in CardViewBadge and add CardViewPlay.
dont: Don't wrap page sections in a card — use plain layout.
Don't set background colours on cards; the surface token keeps both themes correct. For no fill at all, use transparent.
Don't use spotlight on dense lists of small rows — it's for showcase grids and a few large rows.
Don't use view cards for records people select in bulk — use Grid with GridItemSelect and an Action bar.

Don't crop a view card's picture (object-fit: cover) — captures must show whole; the blurred copy fills the gap. Don't put essential information only in its body: it hides until hover on pointer devices.
